The surface of the liquid is smooth but has some small, irregular patterns, possibly from minor disturbances or natural variations in the substance. The lighting is bright, highlighting the glossy texture of the liquid.

A hand enters the frame holding a knife. The knife is held at an angle, with its blade scraping across the surface of the liquid. The hand moves the knife in a circular or back-and-forth motion, actively scraping and moving the substance across the bowl's bottom and sides. The knife's blade reflects light, indicating it is metallic and shiny. The blade becomes coated with the yellow substance as it scrapes across the surface. The liquid is visibly disturbed by the knife's movement, with the substance being moved and spread across the bowl.

The scene continues with the knife being moved in a similar scraping motion across the surface of the liquid, repeating the action of scraping and moving the substance. This sequence is repeated several times, emphasizing the interaction
original_wisa_caption:
The video begins with a close-up shot of a white bowl containing a yellow liquid, which appears to be melted butter or oil. The surface of the liquid is smooth but has some small, irregular patterns, possibly from minor disturbances or natural variations in the substance. The lighting is bright, highlighting the glossy texture of the liquid.

As the video progresses, a hand enters the frame holding a knife. The knife is positioned vertically, with its blade pointing downward into the liquid. The hand moves slightly, causing the knife to dip deeper into the liquid. The knife's blade reflects light, indicating it is metallic and shiny. The hand then lifts the knife out of the liquid, revealing the blade coated with a thin layer of the yellow substance. The liquid remains mostly undisturbed except for the small ripples created by the knife's movement.

The scene continues with the knife being dipped back into the liquid, repeating the action of lifting and coating the blade. This sequence is repeated several times, emphasizing the interaction
caption: A close-up view looks down into a white bowl holding a pool of yellow liquid arranged as an open, U-shaped ring. A paler, foamy mass fills the upper arc. Thinner liquid spreads toward the lower edge. For the first stretch the bowl and its contents remain visually unchanged, with no tool present. Then a metal knife blade, its serrated edge catching the light, enters from the lower right. It presses its tip into the foamy mass and is drawn back and forth across the pool, its insertion point shifting among the right side, center, and left. As it passes, the pale mass and surrounding liquid are locally displaced and deformed, pushed aside and dragged along the surface. The ring outline persists, and the blade's angle and contact point change frame to frame, marking continuous sweeping. The sweeping motion carries on through the final frames. The blade remains in contact with the pool, and the displaced mass remains visibly disturbed around it.

draft_caption: A close-up view looks down into a white bowl holding a pool of yellow liquid arranged as an open, U-shaped ring. A paler, foamy, partly solidified mass fills the upper arc. Thinner liquid spreads toward the lower edge. For the first stretch the bowl and its contents sit undisturbed, with no tool present. Then a metal knife blade, its serrated edge catching the light, enters from the lower right. It presses its tip into the foamy mass and is drawn back and forth across the pool, its insertion point shifting from the right side to the center and then to the left. As it passes, the pale mass and surrounding liquid are locally displaced and deformed, pushed aside and dragged along the surface. The ring outline persists, and the blade's angle and contact point change frame to frame, marking continuous manual sweeping. The sweeping motion carries on through the final frames. The blade remains in contact with the pool, and the displaced mass continues to settle around it.
